purpose: Maps the v42 property-charging demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system.

mappings.product_miss: The coverage matrix already named mobility/vehicle/charging as a high-priority verified domain, but the BRF/property actor had only a housing-adaptation route. A generic answer could therefore collapse a BRF's Ladda bilen application, an economic-activity/property-company project and an individual resident's 2026 charging-point request into one path, creating wrong timing, amount or approval implications.
product_surfaces: shared source registry and support-record schema
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use one property_charging capability in the existing shell/person product. Preserve only explicit coarse context, ask who will use association chargers before applying state-aid/timing rules, ask work-start state on company/economic-activity paths, and send individual resident requests to the separate current housing-law source rather than the organisation grant path. No property charging app or duplicate matcher.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not place address, organisation number, parking-space identifier, exact project cost, quote text, vehicle details, tenancy documents or raw story in URL, public eval feedback or learning events. Handoff is limited to coarse actor/focus/language and optional coarse charging context.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Naturvårdsverket and current Riksdagen/SFS sources govern material claims. The normalized Ladda bilen record remains NEEDS_REVIEW with human review required and zero AI-promoted material fields. Do not infer grant approval, aid intensity, state-aid classification, work-start eligibility or resident statutory eligibility from natural-language input.
